---
title: "02_build_panel"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE)
source(here::here("replication_files", ".rmd_files", "script_files", "paths.R"))
source(here::here("replication_files", ".rmd_files", "script_files", "build_panel.R"))
paths <- project_paths()
```

Functions live in `script_files/build_panel.R` and are tested in `tests/testthat/`.
Input: `data/clean/acs_person.rds` from `01_clean_acs.Rmd`.

```{r inputs}
check_inputs(c(paths$acs_clean, paths$bartik, paths$cw, paths$policy))

acs <- load_acs(paths$acs_clean)
cw  <- read_dta_dt(paths$cw)

cp <- count_cpuma(acs) |>
  merge(wage_cpuma(acs), by = c("cpuma0010", "year"), all.x = TRUE) |>
  add_bartik(read_dta_dt(paths$bartik))

diagnose_merges(cp, cw)
```

```{r panel}
panel <- join_crosswalk(cp, cw) |>
  collapse_cz() |>
  add_policy(read_dta_dt(paths$policy)) |>
  trim_panel() |>
  make_outcomes() |>
  check_panel()
```

## Comparison with the paper (Tables 3 and 4, "Y mean")

```{r compare}
knitr::kable(compare_to_paper(panel), digits = 3)
```

```{r save}
save_panel(panel, paths$cz_panel)
```
